why: An August 2026 arXiv paper by Huang, Jackson, Lee, Poonen, Pries and Zhang proves the Mathieu group M23 occurs as a Galois group over Q, completing the realization of all 26 sporadic simple groups as Galois groups over Q; this settles a specific case of the general inverse Galois problem while the full conjecture remains open. An Epoch AI 'FrontierMath open problems' page also lists this as a problem, suggesting possible AI-system involvement worth checking in the deep dive.
